title: Инсценировка похищения и звонок отцу  (The Staged Kidnapping and the Ransom Call)

segments.t: A mysterious caller phones Nastya's father and demands a hefty ransom that very evening if he wants to see his daughter unharmed. Once the call ends, it is revealed that Nastya is sitting comfortably with her homeless shelter friends, having staged the entire kidnapping herself.
Но мы хотим получить за нее много денег.
Ну, а так все по плану.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'Nastya. Little Nastya.' The meaning hinges on 'Nastya' working together with 'Nastenka' in spoken Russian.
'Good evening once again.' Notice how Russian expresses 'else' and 'evening' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Nastya answers right away.
'Where is my daughter?' The grammar packs 'where' and 'my' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Но мы хотим получить за нее много денег.
'We want to receive a lot of money for her.' In Russian, the idea of 'but' flows naturally into 'of money' without extra filler words.
'This very day.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'today' before landing on 'already'. Senya answers right away.
'How much is a lot?' In Russian, the idea of 'much' flows naturally into 'how much' without extra filler words.
'How much do we need?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'how much' before landing on 'needs to be'.
'It is me.' Senya brings out the contrast between 'this' and 'I' in a few short words. Nastya answers right away.
'And right now.' The meaning hinges on 'both' working together with 'any minute' in spoken Russian.
'Your daughter is going to suffer.' Senya anchors the line on 'your', while 'to suffer' completes the thought.
'My compliments to you.' Nastya anchors the line on 'my', while 'respect' completes the thought. Senya answers right away.
Ну, а так все по плану.
'Well, otherwise everything is going according to plan.' In Russian, the idea of 'come on' flows naturally into 'plan' without extra filler words.
'You will collect the money from my dad.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to take back' before landing on 'dad'. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Но мы хотим получить за нее много денег.
Ну, а так все по плану.
When you watch Scene 5 of Episode 18, listen out for the exchange around the staged kidnapping and the ransom call — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
